title: Manimo Scene Document
description: Editable, round-trippable representation of a scene as a flat list of component instances. Unlike scene-spec.schema.json (a one-way LLM intermediate with freeform position hints), a scene document carries numeric x/y/start/end and per-instance prop overrides, so a visual editor can drag, configure, and re-render it without code generation. motion/render-doc.jsx renders a document; motion/registry.js defines which components and props are valid.

narrationSrc.description: Optional path to a single-track narration mp3.

chrome.description: Optional SceneChrome wrapper (grid, watermark, title block, corner/journey mascot). Omit for a bare canvas.

introEnd.description: If set, Manimo enters centre then glides to the corner by this time.

instances.description: Placed component instances, in paint order (later = on top).

id.description: Unique instance id within the document.

w.description: Box width (defaults to the registry entry's defaultBox.w).

end.description: Sprite end time in seconds (default scene end).

props.description: Per-instance prop overrides; anything unset falls back to the registry default.

groupId.description: Optional. Instances sharing a groupId form a group — selected, moved, and deleted together in the builder.
